description:
Denise Ehler | 512.567.8235
Merry Mitchell Swink | 512.948.6035



4805 Creekside Drive, Killeen, TX

Map it at https://www.google.com/maps/place/4805+Creekside+Drive,+Killeen,+TX

https://www.homeatanywhere.com/4805-Creekside-Drive-Killeen-TX-76543/index.html

Coldwell Banker

ColdwellBankerHomes.com

Situated on two spacious lots totaling over .65 acres, this property offers a truly private, park-like setting with lush landscaping, mature trees and open green space stretching all the way to the creek. Backing to a greenbelt, the expansive yard creates a peaceful retreat perfect for relaxing or entertaining. Enjoy outdoor living at its best with a sparkling pool, covered patio and charming front porch, all surrounded by beautiful tree coverage for shade and privacy. Inside, the home is filled with natural light throughout, featuring a bright and sunny kitchen with a window overlooking the pool. The dining area and main bedroom both showcase French doors that open to the backyard oasis, seamlessly blending indoor and outdoor spaces. Additional highlights include all walk in closets and a brick wood burning fireplace that adds warmth and character to the living area. Major updates include a new roof in 2023 with a full leaf guard gutter system, new HVAC in 2024, new pool liner in 2024, new water heater in 2025 and fresh interior paint in 2026. Move in ready and ideally located, this rare property combines space, privacy and thoughtful updates, all with room to enjoy the beauty of nature right in your own backyard.
